findings.description: Every row's Edit link and Delete button has the identical accessible name with no row context (no aria-label such as 'Edit Train to Pune'), so screen reader users cannot tell which expense an action applies to. Delete also has no confirmation.
repro: Inspect Edit/Delete controls: names are just 'Edit'/'Delete'

notes: Layouts at 1280 and 360, totals (all and filtered), add form and focus outlines looked correct. Did not test edit/delete submissions or viewer permission on direct URLs.

cost.notes: estimate from 20536 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0041-$0.0493
